text_blocks.snippet: The 2025 flu vaccine, like the 2024-2025 vaccine, will be trivalent, protecting against three influenza strains: two type A viruses (H1N1 and H3N2) and one type B virus (Victoria lineage). The B/Yamagata lineage virus, previously included in quadrivalent vaccines, is no longer included because it is not actively circulating.
snippet_highlighted_words: two type A viruses (H1N1 and H3N2) and one type B virus (Victoria lineage)

list.snippet: H1N1: The 2025 vaccine will include an A/Wisconsin/67/2022 (H1N1)pdm09-like virus, according to the FDA.
H3N2: The 2025 vaccine will include an A/District of Columbia/27/2023 (H3N2)-like virus, says the FDA.
Victoria lineage: The 2025 vaccine will include a B/Austria/1359417/2021 (B/Victoria lineage)-like virus, according to the FDA.
Influenza B/Yamagata lineage viruses have not been detected in circulation since March 2020, making their inclusion in the vaccine unnecessary.
This transition to trivalent vaccines simplifies the vaccine composition and reduces the burden on manufacturers.
